members.name: Steve Rulison, EA
members.title: Owner | Enrolled Agent | Tax Consultant
members.bio:
As the owner of Rulison Tax Consulting, Steve Rulison brings over 15 years of experience in tax preparation, consulting, and business advisory services. As an Enrolled Agent (EA), Steve is federally authorized to represent taxpayers before the Internal Revenue Service.

Steve specializes in strategic tax consulting, business entity formation, including S corporations, and business optimization. He works closely with individuals, entrepreneurs, and business owners to develop tax-efficient strategies, streamline operations, and support long-term financial success.

Known for his personalized approach, attention to detail, and commitment to building lasting client relationships, Steve takes pride in helping clients navigate complex tax matters with confidence. His goal is to provide more than just tax preparation—he strives to be a trusted advisor who helps clients make informed decisions and achieve their financial and business goals.

members.name: Ralph Castro
members.title: Tax Accountant | Over 50 Years of Experience
members.bio:
With over 50 years of experience in tax accounting, Ralph Castro has built a remarkable career founded on integrity, hard work, trust, and a genuine commitment to his clients. As a successful business owner, Ralph has dedicated his professional life to providing knowledgeable, personalized tax services while developing lasting relationships with the individuals and families he serves.

What truly sets Ralph apart is the loyalty and trust he has earned throughout the decades. Many of his clients have remained with him for generations, a testament to his dedication, strong work ethic, and sincere care for their financial well-being.

Ralph takes great pride in treating his clients like family, always making their needs a priority and providing the personal attention they deserve. His reputation for honesty, reliability, and exceptional service has been the foundation of his success for more than half a century.

Today, Ralph continues to serve his longtime clients with the same passion, dedication, and personal touch that have defined his career. His experience and lasting relationships are an invaluable part of the Rulison Tax Consulting and Castro Business Services strategic alliance.

members.name: Eric Castro
members.title: Tax Preparer & Financial Consultant
members.bio:
Eric Castro brings an impressive background in finance, business, and management to Rulison Tax Consulting. He earned his MBA from USC with a concentration in Finance and his B.S. in Business Economics from UC Santa Barbara with a concentration in Accounting.

A proud U.S. Air Force veteran, Eric recently retired after an accomplished 25-year career with HP, where he held leadership roles in finance, strategy, business planning, and management.

Known for his strong work ethic, sharp analytical skills, and ability to quickly master new challenges, Eric brings a wealth of experience and a fresh perspective to the tax profession. He will be working closely alongside Ralph Castro, combining his financial expertise with Ralph’s decades of tax experience to provide clients with the trusted, personalized service they have come to expect.

Eric’s dedication, professionalism, and commitment to excellence make him a valuable addition to our family business.

members.name: Gloria Duarte
members.title: Tax Preparer | Over 40 Years of Dedicated Service
members.bio:
With over 40 years of dedicated service to our family business, Gloria Duarte has been an invaluable part of our team and its continued success. Her extensive knowledge, exceptional work ethic, and commitment to excellence have earned her the trust and loyalty of generations of clients.

Known for her professionalism, reliability, and genuine care for others, Gloria has built lasting relationships with clients who continue to rely on her year after year. Her dedication, experience, and personal approach truly reflect the values and traditions of our family business.

members.name: Leanna Jaurique
members.title: Administrative Assistant | Over 5 Years of Dedicated Service
members.bio:
With over five years of dedicated service to our family business, Leanna Jaurique plays an important role in keeping our office running smoothly and ensuring our clients receive the attention and care they deserve.

Known for her strong work ethic, reliability, and team-oriented attitude, Leanna takes pride in providing exceptional client support. Her dedication, positive attitude, and willingness to go above and beyond make her a valued member of the Rulison Tax Consulting family.

members.name: Lorena Lopez
members.title: Tax Preparer | Over 10 Years of Experience
members.bio:
With over 10 years of experience in tax preparation, Lorena Lopez brings extensive knowledge, professionalism, and dedication to Rulison Tax Consulting. Previously serving as both a manager and tax preparer at H&R Block, she has developed strong expertise in tax preparation, client service, and leadership.

Known for her intelligence, exceptional work ethic, and attention to detail, Lorena is committed to providing accurate, personalized service. Her dedication to her clients and genuine desire to help others make her a valued member of our team.

members.name: Erika Rulison
members.title: Tax Preparer | Real Estate Broker
members.bio:
As the daughter of Ralph Castro and wife of Steve Rulison, Erika Rulison proudly carries on the family tradition of hard work, integrity, and dedication. In addition to serving as a tax preparer, Erika brings over 25 years of experience as a real estate broker, where she has built a reputation for professionalism, reliability, and exceptional client service.

With a strong commitment to her family’s business, Erika takes pride in building lasting relationships, supporting clients, and helping the firm continue to grow and succeed. Her dedication, strong work ethic, and genuine care for others reflect the values at the heart of Rulison Tax Consulting.

members.name: Blake Rulison
members.title: Tax Preparer | Third-Generation Family Member
members.bio:
As the son of Steve and Erika Rulison and grandson of Ralph Castro, Blake Rulison proudly represents the third generation of our family business. He continues the family legacy of hard work, integrity, and dedication to serving our clients.

Known for his strong work ethic, reliability, and willingness to learn and grow, Blake is a valuable asset to our team. His commitment to providing quality service and upholding the values established by his family reflects the tradition of trust and personalized care that has defined our business for generations.
